run_image_cal.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) runs the `sx127x` image calibration, must be in standby mode.

data.docs:
**list**: The packet to send, length should match the configured payload_length.

*See also: [SX127x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x#configuration-variables)*

send_packet.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) sends a packet, the `sx127x` needs to be in packet mode.

set_mode_rx.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) sets the `sx127x` mode to rx.

set_mode_sleep.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) sets the `sx127x` mode to sleep.

set_mode_standby.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) sets the `sx127x` mode to standby.

set_mode_tx.docs: This [action](https://esphome.io/automations/actions#all-actions) sets the `sx127x` mode to tx.

auto_cal.docs:
**bool**: Enable automatic image calibration on temperature changes. Defaults to `true`.

*See also: [SX127x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x#configuration-variables)*

bitrate.docs:
**int**: Bit rate of the signal. Required in packet mode and recommended in continuous mode. Normally the inverse of the bit duration, eg 1 / 208 us is 4800 bps.

*See also: [SX127x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x#configuration-variables)*

bitsync.docs:
**bool**: Enables the receive bit synchronizer. Required in packet mode. Recommended in continuous mode, however if there is no preamble plus high noise it may be better to turn it off.

*See also: [SX127x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x#configuration-variables)*

coding_rate.docs:
**enum**: Coding rate, values can be `CR_4_5`, `CR_4_6`, `CR_4_7` or `CR_4_8`. Defaults to `CR_4_5`.

*See also: [SX127x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x#configuration-variables)*

crc_enable.docs:
**bool**: Enables a 16 bit CRC calculation/check in packet mode.

*See also: [SX127x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x#configuration-variables)*

deviation.docs:
**frequency**: Transmitter FSK frequency deviation, values range from 0 to 100 kHz. Defaults to `5kHz`.

*See also: [SX127x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x#configuration-variables)*

frequency.docs:
**frequency**: Frequency in Hz of the transceiver.

*See also: [SX127x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x#configuration-variables)*

on_packet.docs:
**[Automation](https://esphome.io/automations)**: An automation to perform in packet mode when a packet has been decoded. A variable x of type `std::vector<uint8_t>` is passed to the automation for use in lambdas. In LoRa mode the variables snr and rssi are also available.

*See also: [SX127x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x#configuration-variables)*

pa_pin.docs:
**enum**: Transmitter output pin, can be `BOOST` or `RFO`.

*See also: [SX127x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x#configuration-variables)*

pa_power.docs:
**int**: Transmitter power, range is from 2 to 17 dBm when `pa_pin` is `BOOST` and 0 to 15 dBm when using `RFO`.

*See also: [SX127x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x#configuration-variables)*

pa_ramp.docs:
**enum**: Transmitter PA ramp, can be `10us`, `12us`, `15us`, `20us`, `25us`, `31us`, `40us`, `50us`, `62us`, `100us`, `125us`, `250us`, `500us`, `1000us`, `2000us` or `3400us`.

*See also: [SX127x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x#configuration-variables)*

packet_mode.docs:
**bool**: In packet mode bytes are sent via the `send_packet` automation and received with the `on_packet` trigger. If not enabled continuous mode is used and raw data is sent and received on DIO2.

*See also: [SX127x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x#configuration-variables)*

payload_length.docs:
**int**: Length of the payload in packet mode. If not configured then the variable length packet format is used. Maximum length is 64.

*See also: [SX127x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x#configuration-variables)*

preamble_detect.docs:
**int**: Minimum length of the preamble in bytes required by the receiver. Preamble detector is disabled if the size is 0 and its value capped at 3.

*See also: [SX127x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x#configuration-variables)*

preamble_errors.docs:
**int**: Number of chip errors tolerated in the receiver.

*See also: [SX127x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x#configuration-variables)*

preamble_polarity.docs:
**int**: Polarity of the preamble, either 0xAA or 0x55.

*See also: [SX127x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x#configuration-variables)*

preamble_size.docs:
**int**: Length of the preamble, in bytes, to be sent by the transmitter. This value should be larger than `preamble_detect` on the receive side to allow time for the receiver’s AFC and AGC to adjust.

*See also: [SX127x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x#configuration-variables)*

rx_floor.docs:
**float**: When receiving OOK `rx_floor` should be set appropriately for your environment. If set too high (ie closer to 0) the radio will ignore everything. If set too low (ie closer to -128) too much noise will get through. When receiving FSK without a preamble configured `rx_floor` is used to trigger the receiver.

*See also: [SX127x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x#configuration-variables)*

rx_start.docs:
**bool**: Start the receiver automatically on boot or after transmitting.

*See also: [SX127x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x#configuration-variables)*

shaping.docs:
**enum**: Transmitter data shaping. In OOK can be `CUTOFF_BR_X_2`, `CUTOFF_BR_X_1` or `NONE`. In FSK can be `GAUSSIAN_BT_0_3`, `GAUSSIAN_BT_0_5`, `GAUSSIAN_BT_1_0` or `NONE`. Not recommended in continuous mode as the data on DIO2 must to be synchronized with the bit clock on DIO1.

*See also: [SX127x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x#configuration-variables)*

spreading_factor.docs:
**int**: Spreading factor, values range from 6 to 12. Defaults to 7.

*See also: [SX127x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x#configuration-variables)*

sync_value.docs:
**list**: Synchronization bytes, list of 1 to 8 bytes, found after the preamble and before the payload.

*See also: [SX127x Component](https://esphome.io/components/sx127x#configuration-variables)*
